scope: Existing same-student four-sequence ten-frame captures, all six S2 blocks. Finite local services and shared-bus lower bounds; not full cycles, RTL, PPA or system speed.

shared_wide_state.L1: One shared96-lane update port and adder; layout does not change service.
shared_wide_state.L7: Seven independent96-lane state read/write/update ports and adders; common W broadcast, independent destinations. Plane and striped are fixed layouts for all routes; seven ports are a different resource platform from L1.
shared_wide_state.update: Each enabled bank has one96-lane read and one96-lane write per beat. II1 with two-beat completion and forwarding; per-slot valid bits avoid wide zero initialization. First writes still pay service. Negative signed coordinates use subtraction at the same service rate. These are RF/register state ports, not claimed1RW SRAM ports.

coefficients.stripe_schedule: P32 outer,H96 inner; all16 stripes refilled for every spatial tile. No full-W residence.
coefficients.mask_hardware: 32 parallel3-bit decoders, fixed layout wiring and seven32-bit priority queues; same provisioning for every route. Decoder logic and fanout are not physically mapped.

source.encoder: 32 parallel ROMs, one C-column of at most32 coordinates per beat; required raw6/7 time decisions. ROM replication is charged. Original PSN producer and its layout cost lie outside this boundary.

PSN.service: Common single vector MAC/comparator pipeline for all platforms. Static nonzero coefficient schedule and support-live slots; no speculative numeric cancellation.

external_bus.hiding: Next stripe writes may overlap only current PSN register service after tau preload. Window slack is a necessary bandwidth opportunity, not a complete arbitration proof.

metric_notes.serialized_local_service_beats: FC1 finite-bank service +46 tau/template bank beats per stripe +PSN local service. Stages serialized; excludes external-bus arbitration, source encode and producer. Comparisons are component service ratios only.
metric_notes.psn_local_service_beats: Existing PSN schedule minus final external packet beat. May stall on a full output FIFO; that global stall is not simulated.
metric_notes.fc1_state_vector_writes: Actual96-lane state updates; L7 broadcast issue beats count max per-bank destinations for each W, never total updates/7.
metric_notes.valid_clear: One beat clears224 support-valid bits per spatial/hidden tile; no free copy of a wide tensor.
metric_notes.theta: Source theta was folded by the saved integer compiler; final theta*g preserved. This same trained integer student is not frozen FP32 ep34 equivalence.
metric_notes.comparator: Actual six modules have zero negative-gain and zero constant-gain channels, so static comparison direction is positive throughout. This is checked from saved parameters; no general positive-gain assumption.
metric_notes.source: All three routes use the same encoded3-bit source. Frontend input is required source decisions in column/tile order; actual producer reordering/transpose is not modeled.
metric_notes.finite_width: INT24 and INT48 range bounds checked from actual W and coefficients; no source floating tensor or intermediate fullY is silently cached.
metric_notes.omitted: No all-stage overlap timeline, physical timing/area/energy, encoder/queue circuit delay, source PSN production, real FC2/BN2 or shortcut service. No RTL or network speed claim.
